name: family-trip-agent
description: Plan, replan, publish, and learn from executable family road trips.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, replan, and learn from executable family road trips
interface.longDescription: A local-first family road-trip agent that separates plan from reality, validates execution risks, replans when conditions change, and learns only from user-confirmed feedback.
defaultPrompt: Plan an executable family road trip with verified global sources.
Replan today's trip after weather, fatigue, traffic, or a closure.
Compare the plan with reality and propose family rules for confirmation.
